item.title: At an Italian hedgehog hospital, tiny patients face the strain of a warming climate
item.description: Italy's only hedgehog rescue center is overwhelmed with underweight hoglets due to climate change. Prolonged drought and high temperatures have led to a spike in rescues at the La Ninna center in Piedmont.
